name: GS_Q_PERSONAS_FOR_JSON
query: SELECT (SELECT ID_PERSONA AS idPersona, NOMBRE AS nombre, APELLIDO AS apellido, EDAD AS edad, EMAIL AS email, FECHA_NACIMIENTO AS fechaNacimiento, ACTIVO AS activo, FECHA_REGISTRO AS fechaRegistro FROM dbo.GS_PERSONA WHERE ACTIVO = ? ORDER BY ID_PERSONA FOR JSON PATH) AS personas_json
